semantics.ordering_rule: Evaluation order only where prerequisites require.
semantics.composition_rule: Rule membership does not change rule ownership.
semantics.version_rule: Rule-set membership change creates new revision/version.
semantics.authority_rule: Rule set does not lock source.

invariants.rule: Every conformance rule has exact identity, scope, inputs, predicate/evaluation semantics, severity/blocking behavior and finding representation.
Conformance rules never rely on newest-wins, mtime, filename similarity, path proximity, UI layout, fuzzy identity matching or undocumented implementation defaults.

hard_gates.condition: rule-set order changes semantics without declaration
